name: What types of remodels offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What types of remodels offer the best return on investment for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on updates that enhance functionality and broad appeal. Kitchen and bathroom remodels often yield high returns, especially cosmetic updates like new countertops, fixtures, and fresh paint. Durable, low-maintenance flooring like luxury vinyl plank is also a smart investment. Consider adding in-unit laundry or improving curb appeal with landscaping, which can attract higher-paying tenants and reduce vacancy periods. Prioritize repairs over aesthetics if essential systems like HVAC or plumbing are outdated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom remodels, along with durable flooring and in-unit laundry, typically offer the best return on investment for rental properties.
